newsitem.title: USA: Family Bargain Feb same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Family Bargain Feb same store sales rise.

text.p: Family Bargain Corp. Thursday said sales for the four-week period ended March 1 increased 17.2 percent to $14.3 million, compared with $12.2 million last year.
Comparable store sales for February were flat from the prior year.
Last year's same store sales for the month of February were up 15.8 percent over the previous year. The company operated 152 stores as of March 1, compared with 131 stores as of March 2, 1996.
